about_the_game:
Welcome to Chronicles of Crossing Time.

In this game, you will experience the intense battle for succession in an imperial court. Whether you are drawn into it passively or choose to take part actively, every decision you make will involve intricate struggles of human nature—conflicts, political intrigue, intertwining relationships, life and death, separation and farewells, and of course, sweet moments of romance.

Beyond the game’s content itself, I’d like to share a bit about the creation of this game.

This is an interactive story-driven game that I developed entirely on my own. Unlike large-scale productions, this genre does not rely on complex mechanics or interactive systems. Instead, I focused most of my efforts on crafting the story. Think of it more like a drama where the audience can shape the fate of the characters. I have tried to avoid awkward dialogue or forced plot twists, striving to ensure that each character’s actions are logical and that the story flows naturally.

As for the visuals, sound effects, and background music—all of them are supported by AI tools. I am grateful for how AI technology has helped bring my ideas to life (though I must say, AI is still a long way from being a complete replacement for creative production).

The game offers multiple possible endings depending on your choices. How many? Two? Three? Four? Or perhaps more? That is for you to discover on your own. I have carefully written each ending with a complete storyline, ensuring consistent depth and quality—there will be no rushed or incomplete conclusions.

If you enjoy rich, emotionally resonant narratives and vivid, well-rounded characters—and if you are willing to immerse yourself in such a story—I hope that Chronicles of Crossing Time will offer you an enjoyable and memorable experience.

If you have any thoughts or feedback, I warmly welcome you to reach out and connect.

short_description: 《穿越日记》是一款沉浸式互动剧情游戏，玩家将扮演一名穿越入盛世皇城的现代女性，亲历宫廷风云与权谋博弈。通过选择不同剧情分支，推动故事走向多个结局，体验细腻的人物情感与复杂的人心博弈。支持单人离线游玩，适用于 Windows 和 macOS 平台，适合喜爱剧情向、宫廷题材及互动叙事体验的玩家。
